description: This file contains a simple graphics program that sets up a drawing window, responds to mouse and wheel events to draw lines and circles with adjustable stroke weight.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the drawing interface, handles drawing lines or circles based on mouse input, and displays instructions.

methods.name: mousePressed
methods.description: Records the current mouse position when pressed.

methods.name: mouseWheel
methods.description: Adjusts the stroke weight based on scroll delta, constraining it between 1 and 100.
